'''Felucian Sanctuary''' was a village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].

==History==
The village was located deep in the Felucian jungle, where it was hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was home to a group of [[Felucian/Legends|Felucians]] and following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vazus Mandrake]] went there to live with them. When a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents traveled to Felucia in about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], they visited the village.
